brands.title: Brand Profiles
brands.subtitle: Every generated asset follows the brand it is written for
brands.none: No brands yet. Create one to start planning content.
brands.edit_subtitle: Identity, offering, audience, voice and visual guidelines
brands.analysis_help: Reads a few public pages and proposes a profile. Nothing changes until you review it.
brands.review_help: Review the proposal. Choose what to take into the profile; everything else stays as it is.
brands.name: Brand name
brands.logo_hint: Upload the logo in the Image Studio, then choose it here
brands.start_help: Give us your website address. AI Studio reads it and fills in your whole brand profile — what you sell, who you sell to, your voice, colours, logo and contact details. You check it and correct anything before it is used.
brands.reading_help: This takes about a minute. Your profile fills in here as soon as it is done.
brands.failed_help: Try again, check the address, or fill in the profile yourself below.
brands.filled_title: We filled in your profile from {site}
brands.filled_help: Check every field and correct anything that is wrong or missing — nothing is used until you save.
brands.section_offering: What you offer, and to whom
brands.visual_style_hint: The kind of pictures that suit you, e.g. "bright photos of real customers, modern and clean"
brands.enter_by_hand: No website? Enter the details yourself

campaigns.title: AI Campaign Planner
campaigns.subtitle: From a brief to a strategy to a calendar of content
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.approval_required: Content needs approval before it is scheduled
campaigns.no_strategy: Generate a strategy from the brief: objectives, themes and a weekly plan you can edit.
campaigns.strategy_edit_hint: Edit freely, then Save — the plan uses what you keep.

plan.title: Plan my month
plan.help: Tell us how often, where and about what. AI Studio writes every post, designs its picture, carousel or video, and puts it on the calendar waiting for your review. Nothing is published until it is approved.
plan.milestones_hint: For example: 15 Nov product launch; 28 Nov Black Friday
plan.what_formats: What to make (the formats take turns)
plan.topics_placeholder:
One per line, e.g.
Winter specials
Customer success story
How our app saves time
plan.topics_hint: Leave empty and AI Studio picks topics from your brand profile.
plan.auto_design: Design the pictures, carousels and videos automatically
plan.auto_design_hint: Each post is designed with your logo and colours and waits for review on the calendar.
plan.more_options: More options: days, times, language, goal

calendar.title: Social Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Times are in {tz}. Drag a post to move it.
calendar.creator: Creator
calendar.move_failed: The post could not be moved.
calendar.day_actions_help: Regenerate replaces only drafts that are not approved or scheduled. Approve checks every post; any that cannot be approved are listed.
calendar.add_help: Adds a draft at this time. Other posts at the same time stay as they are.
calendar.creating_n: {n} post(s) are being designed. They appear here as they are finished.
calendar.designing: This post is being designed. It appears here in a minute.
calendar.caption: Caption

content.title: Content Studio
content.subtitle: Everything written for your brands
content.brief_hint: What to write, for whom and why. The AI uses only facts from the brand profile and this brief.
content.check_facts: Written by AI: check every fact, name and figure before submitting it for approval.
content.in_workflow: This content is in the company's approval workflow; it is decided from My Work.
content.caption: Caption
content.proposal: AI proposal — nothing changes until you choose it

images.title: AI Image Studio
images.subtitle: Branded designs, AI images and uploads for your posts
images.template_help: Rendered by Mkhaya with your brand colours and logo. The text is exactly what you type — the safe choice for offers, dates and prices.
images.headline: Headline
images.ai_help: AI images can get text, logos and hands wrong. Check them, and add exact text with a branded design instead.

videos.title: AI Video Studio
videos.subtitle: Mkhaya Media Engine: branded videos with voiceover and exact subtitles
videos.engine_body: Branded template videos, AI voiceover and automatic subtitles are rendered by Mkhaya's own Media Engine, which arrives in its own phase. Upload finished videos here meanwhile; they can be scheduled like any post.
videos.engine_missing_title: The Media Engine is not installed on this server yet
videos.engine_missing_body: Rendering needs ffmpeg on the server (and Piper for voiceover). You can draft and edit scenes now; rendering works once your administrator installs them — see Integrations.
videos.no_voice: No voiceover voices are installed, so videos render with subtitles and music only. Ask your administrator to add Piper voices.
videos.from_post: From a post or script in Content Studio
videos.script_hint: What the video should say. The AI drafts scenes from it; you can change every word before rendering.

library.title: Content Library
library.subtitle: Every image and video, stored securely in Mkhaya

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Content waiting for a decision
approvals.subtitle_sod: Content waiting for a decision. You cannot approve content you wrote or submitted.

accounts.title: Social Accounts
accounts.subtitle: One set of connections for the whole platform
accounts.no_connect: Accounts are connected through Content Marketing → Social. Ask an administrator to enable it for your company.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Production and publishing across brands and campaigns (last 90 days)
analytics.engagement_unavailable: Engagement figures (reach, reactions, views) appear here once posts have been published and read back from the networks, hourly. Until then they show as unavailable — never estimated.
analytics.subtitle2: Reports, trends and recommendations from what you published
analytics.rate_hint: Engagement rate = (reactions + comments + shares) ÷ reach, where the network reports reach.
analytics.estimates: Estimates from {n} published post(s) with engagement figures — a guide, not a guarantee.
analytics.not_enough: Recommendations need at least {needed} published posts with engagement figures; there are {n} so far.

usage.title: Usage & Credits
usage.subtitle: What AI Studio work has cost, and what is left
usage.no_plan: No AI Studio plan yet: the standard {n} credits a month apply, with no limits. Ask Mkhaya about a plan.
usage.overage_block: When credits run out, work stops until next month or a top-up.
usage.overage_bill: When credits run out, work carries on at {price} a credit, up to {cap} extra credits a month.
usage.overage_bill_nocap: When credits run out, work carries on at {price} a credit.
usage.buy_hint: Top-up credits never expire and are used after the monthly allowance.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: The engines and connections AI Studio runs on

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How AI Studio works for your company
settings.timezone_hint: Calendar times are entered and shown in this zone and stored in UTC.
settings.mode_approval: Approval-based — content is approved before it is scheduled
settings.mode_manual: Manual — authorised people schedule without approval
settings.mode_autopilot: Autopilot — arrives in a later phase, off by default
settings.sod_hint: Nobody approves content they wrote or submitted.
settings.autopilot_hint: Off by default. When off, every autopilot policy is switched off too.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.subtitle: Every channel publishes on its own. Times in {tz}.
publishing.missed: {n} post(s) are more than 15 minutes overdue and have not started. The scheduler may not be running — check the server cron.
publishing.disconnected: Posts are waiting for channels that are not connected: {list}.
publishing.empty_queue: Nothing is queued in the next two weeks.
publishing.empty_going: Nothing is going out right now.
publishing.empty_published: Nothing published in the last 30 days.
publishing.check_body: The network did not confirm this post. Open the account and look for it. If it is there, record it as published (paste its address if you have it). If it is not, retry it — it will not be posted twice.

assistants.title: Digital Humans
assistants.subtitle: Illustrated AI assistants that talk, answer from your knowledge and hand over to your team
assistants.how: Mkhaya's assistants are illustrated characters drawn in the visitor's browser. They speak with the browser's own voice, answer only from the knowledge you give them, and never pretend to be human.
assistants.name: Name
assistants.knowledge_help: Teach the assistant with public pages, documents, FAQs or notes. It answers only from these — never from other company records.
assistants.question: Question
assistants.no_sources: Nothing learned yet. An assistant needs at least one source before it can be published.
assistants.actions: What it may do when a visitor asks
assistants.escalate_hint: They get leads, callbacks and hand-overs; the first also owns CRM leads and tickets.
assistants.retention_hint: Off by default (POPIA). When off, only counts are kept.
assistants.embed_help: Name the websites it may appear on, publish, then paste the code before </body> on those sites. No keys are exposed and it cannot be framed anywhere else.
assistants.embed_after_publish: The code works once the assistant is published.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.subtitle: AI keeps your calendar filled a few days ahead — within the limits you set
autopilot.paused_all: All automation was paused at {at}. Autopilot posts were taken off the schedule.
autopilot.company_off: Autopilot is switched off for this company. Switch it on in
autopilot.rules: Autopilot never gets round your rules: its posts go for approval unless your company requires none, it posts only on the channels, days and times you allow, never in quiet periods, and never above the post and credit limits. A post that mentions a prohibited subject is held as a draft.
autopilot.limits_line: Up to {day} a day, {week} a week · {credits} credits a week · {horizon} days ahead
autopilot.name: Policy name
autopilot.prohibited_hint: Separate with commas. Posts that mention one are held for a person.
autopilot.auto_needs_manual: Scheduling without approval needs the company approval setting to be Manual.
autopilot.emergency_body: Every policy is paused at once and every autopilot post that has not gone out is taken off the schedule. Posts people scheduled are not touched.

rec.day: Posts on this day drew {lift}% more engagement than average.
rec.time: Posts around this hour drew {lift}% more engagement than average.
rec.format: This format drew {lift}% more engagement than average.
rec.theme: This theme drew {lift}% more engagement than average.
rec.mix: Video posts drew {value}× the engagement of image posts; {share}% of your posts are video.
rec.frequency: You publish about {value} posts a week. Keep a steady rhythm before changing it, and compare engagement after.
rec.reuse_title: Worth reusing (older than 30 days, most engaging)
